download_url.description: Absolute or registry-relative URL the artifact can be fetched from.

mirrors.description:
Alternate fetch locations (public R2, GitHub Release) so a client that
already has this metadata can retry without the registry host. Empty
when the publisher did not advertise mirrors; clients still guess
standard GitHub/R2 paths from `org`/`name`/`vcs_tag`.

ArtifactFormat.description: On-the-wire formats for published package artifacts.

ArtifactLocator.description: One concrete fetch location for a published artifact.

ArtifactSourceKind.description:
Where a published artifact can be fetched from when the primary registry
host is down. Order in [`artifact_locators`] is the client retry order.

oneOf.description: Direct GET against the public R2/CDN origin.
Packed tarball attached to a GitHub Release.

Packed artifact stored as an OCI artifact on GitHub Packages (GHCR).
This is the GitHub surface that shows on
`https://github.com/orgs/{org}/packages`.

Source archive of the tagged commit. Last resort: the bytes are the
VCS tree, not the pruned publish artifact, so a lockfile sha256 will
not match unless the client re-packs with the same rules.
